name: testsmt16.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (verify1 Ref)(timeVar Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((TimePoint (mk-TimePoint (t Int)))))
(declare-sort DurativeEvent) (declare-const mk-DurativeEvent DurativeEvent)
(declare-datatypes () ((VerifyEVR (mk-VerifyEVR (cmd String)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-TimePoint (sel-TimePoint TimePoint))
  (lift-DurativeEvent (sel-DurativeEvent DurativeEvent))
  (lift-VerifyEVR (sel-VerifyEVR VerifyEVR))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-TimePoint ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TimePoint (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TimePoint ((this Ref)) TimePoint
  (sel-TimePoint (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-DurativeEvent ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-DurativeEvent (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-DurativeEvent ((this Ref)) DurativeEvent
  (sel-DurativeEvent (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-VerifyEVR ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-VerifyEVR (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-VerifyEVR ((this Ref)) VerifyEVR
  (sel-VerifyEVR (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-TimePoint ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TimePoint this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-DurativeEvent ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-DurativeEvent this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-VerifyEVR ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-VerifyEVR this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.verify1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!verify1 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (verify1 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.timeVar: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!timeVar ((this Ref)) Ref
  (timeVar (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (deref (TopLevelDeclarations!verify1 this)) (lift-VerifyEVR (mk-VerifyEVR "CMD_NO_OP")))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-VerifyEVR (TopLevelDeclarations!verify1 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-TimePoint (TopLevelDeclarations!timeVar this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))



; ----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TimePoint:
; ----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-TimePoint TimePoint)
(declare-const const-2-TimePoint TimePoint)



; --------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class DurativeEvent:
; --------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-DurativeEvent DurativeEvent)



; ----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class VerifyEVR:
; ----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-VerifyEVR VerifyEVR)
(declare-const const-5-VerifyEVR VerifyEVR)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-TimePoint const-1-TimePoint))
        2 (lift-TimePoint const-2-TimePoint))
        3 (lift-DurativeEvent const-3-DurativeEvent))
        4 (lift-VerifyEVR const-4-VerifyEVR))
        5 (lift-VerifyEVR const-5-VerifyEVR))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (verify1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= a!1 (lift-VerifyEVR (mk-VerifyEVR "CMD_NO_OP")))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (verify1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-VerifyEVR a!1)))
(define-fun const-2-TimePoint () TimePoint
  (mk-TimePoint 10))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (timeVar (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-TimePoint a!1)))
(define-fun const-4-VerifyEVR () VerifyEVR
  (mk-VerifyEVR "CMD_NO_OP"))
(define-fun const-5-VerifyEVR () VerifyEVR
  (mk-VerifyEVR "BEFGH"))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 4 2))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun const-1-TimePoint () TimePoint
  (mk-TimePoint 0))
(define-fun const-3-DurativeEvent () DurativeEvent
  DurativeEvent!val!0)
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations
                           (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 4 2)))
                  1
                  (lift-TimePoint (mk-TimePoint 0)))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 2 (lift-TimePoint (mk-TimePoint 10)))
                  3
                  (lift-DurativeEvent DurativeEvent!val!0))))
  (store (store a!2 4 (lift-VerifyEVR (mk-VerifyEVR "CMD_NO_OP")))
         5
         (lift-VerifyEVR (mk-VerifyEVR "BEFGH"))))))
